board: SparkFun Sound Detector SEN-12642 (SEN-14262 with headers)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico: ENVELOPE (0-5 V level, 100 ohm op-amp output) and GATE (active-high push-pull) are simulated on a 5 V supply through 10k/15k dividers, which the driver undoes, printing ENV=2.0V GATE=1. AUDIO (waveform on VCC/2) is in the pinout and driver but not simulated, because the sim cannot drive a wave and a second analog output on the same part.
